configuration.question: Does hard preservation add value beyond ordinary shrinkage toward the existing geometry intercept and slope?
configuration.formula: eta=(bG+db)+(wG+dw)*zG+alpha*zA; penalty=.5*(factor/nC)*(db^2+dw^2+alpha^2); wG+dw>=0,alpha>=0. Baseline and all statistics are fitted only in permitted C training partitions. Hard fixed is db=dw=0, not a novel mathematical claim.
configuration.selection: Exactly existing factors .01,.1,1,10,100 plus explicit unchanged-G candidate. Reuse original hard-rule 3 outer fold base heads, RGB stats, inner base-selection receipts. Same fold groups, 5factor candidate budget and pooled balanced OOF Brier, exact ties prefer unchangedG then factor nearest1. No jointly selecting hard vs soft by V.
configuration.fit_budget: 15 new outerfold centered heads + at most6 final centered heads (two domain ensembles and each of2 existing seeds/domain). Existing bases/fold heads reused without refitting. Same sourceC-selected factor applied to PD C110 and all single-seed fits, no target or per-seed search.
configuration.external_constraints: No new data, no Eye/SiM, no neural training/forwards. Historical V already DEV. Domain-specific foreground/fallback and within-domain trained models unchanged. This does not repair historical development exposure or create independent confirmation.
configuration.endpoints: Retain every original ALL/KNOWN/EXCLUDED/dent cohort and eligible class. Two existing seeds plus existing ensemble reported separately; no best-seed selection. Logit class macro AUROC and class/label-balanced Brier.5000 paired class-label acquisition-group percentile bootstrap, fixed models/classes, unadjusted exploratory intervals.
configuration.stop: Save chosen factor and all six final heads before reading V score arrays. One pass only. If centered shrinkage matches/beats hard, narrow the hard-specific contribution; do not expand factors or tune alpha after V.
